name: AI + 3D + Motion + Real Website
philosophy: A flagship production: one world, told through cinematic scroll, anchored by a real-time 3D centrepiece, with real content and production discipline. The parts are one film, never a collage.
principles: One world and one concept across all parts
The 3D object is the protagonist of the scroll story
Only one WebGL canvas at a time
visualIdentity: Enterprise-flagship scale: a single monumental idea (a globe, an engine, a building) carried from the first screen to the last.
artDirection: Direct it like a film with a hero prop. Light, grade and type stay constant so scroll and 3D feel like one medium.

layout.composition: Pinned chapters staged around the 3D centrepiece, relieved by quieter proof sections and a real multi-page structure.

typography: Monumental display type plus precise annotation labels.
colour: A controlled cinematic grade that the 3D lighting also follows.
contentPresentation: A narrative for the flagship page, with full supporting pages for real business content.
assets: One heavy hero asset within budget; the team hit load problems with several. Licensed models, poster frames for each chapter.
animation: Camera moves tied to scroll chapters, overlays synced to camera, scrubbed reveals.
scrolling: Lenis with ScrollTrigger; 3D paused when out of view.
responsive: Drops to APP-01 plus APP-02 on weak devices; each 3D part falls back to its poster.
avoidFor: Sites without one strong central idea

compatibleWith.when: A shader scene is one chapter of the same world

fromTeam: Workbook: 3D globe with shipping arcs and scroll camera, first version judged visually weak, heavy assets
Skill: composite of APP-02 and APP-03 with one budget and one canvas
